samples.audit: 정답위치 코드생성됨(치환·밑줄 모두 코드처리) · 어휘 위치검증 통과

q.instruction: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?
q.passage: Nouns 5 ⓐ<u>Popular</u> ⓑ<u>names</u> of places are ⓒ<u>usually</u> ⓓ<u>capitalized</u> (and not enclosed in quotation marks). For example: Badlands (South Dakota) Eastern Shore (Chesapeake Bay) Bay Area (California) Fertile Crescent Strangely enough, words derived from geographical names are ⓔ<u>specifically</u> not capitalized. For example: china (dishes) plaster of paris french fries venetian blinds Capitalization of Things. The complete names of private and public organizations of all kinds are capitalized. For example: Cheney High School Peace Corps Green Bay Packers (football team) Xerox Corporation New York Philharmonic The names of historical, political, and economic events are generally capitalized. For example: Boston Tea Party New Deal Great Depression The names of acts, treaties, laws, and government programs are generally capitalized. For example: Declaration of Independence Marshall Plan Federal Housing Act Monroe Doctrine The names of months and the days of the week are capitalized, but not the names of the seasons. For example: fall summer February Wednesday spring winter
q.explanation:
정답 ⓔ는 'specifically'인데 문맥상 원래의 'generally'가 적절하다.
【출제의도】 문맥상 적절한 낱말 쓰임(반의·유의 혼동)을 판단하는 능력을 평가한다.

q.instruction: 다음 글에 드러난 'I'의 심경 변화로 가장 적절한 것은?
q.explanation:
글의 핵심 논지는 'Capitalization is used for proper nouns—place names, organizations, historical events, laws, and dates—while common nouns and derived terms remain lowercase.'이며 정답 (고유명사 대문자)이 이를 반영한다.
【출제의도】 지문의 핵심 내용을 조건에 맞게 영어로 산출/해석하는 표현력·정확성을 평가한다(조건 준수 포함). [핵심 논지: Capitalization is used for proper nouns—place names, organizations, historical events, laws, and dates—while common nouns and derived terms remain lowercase.]
